records.derivative_scope: Differentiated implicit equation; numerical Moser first/second and time sensitivities; full H AD3. Not finite-iteration program exactness.

base.model: 3D inextensible unshearable Kirchhoff strain Ritz; exact SO(3) frame updates and midpoint centerline embedding
base.configuration: four Legendre curvature coefficients in each of two bending axes and torsion by default; all are dynamical
base.mass: configuration dependent; includes translational and rotary inertia from embedding Jacobians
base.KAM_status: Standard nonresonant elliptic KAM is not certified; circular isotropic rod with axial bias has paired bending frequencies.
base.relation_to_full_model: Shares material, distal magnet and field interface with the Cosserat model; shear/stretch omitted in this analytical ROM; modal truncation and fluid/contact closure errors are not yet bounded.
base.input: 12 total coil currents in A; no separate 8-field increment input or extra ideal bias
base.drag: synthetic smooth gamma*P; not a blood/contact closure
base.derivatives: double-precision automatic differentiation through full variable-mass SO(3) geometry
base.magnetism: Full circular-coil Biot-Savart energy; no additional ideal bias

coil_config.status: Engineering geometry and ratings; unbuilt and uncalibrated air-core coil benchmark

base.bias_initialization: Pre-energized fixed local axial-bias fit; not a zero-current startup
base.feedback_derivative: Hamiltonian partial z derivative first; compose i(z) afterwards; total field Jacobian contains Di/Dz
base.magnetic_domain: Away from ideal circular wires; physical_samples evaluates actual magnet quadrature points only
base.constraints: Smooth feedback not automatically bounded; coil_control handles explicit constrained current ramps.

metadata.high_order_ad_identity: 0.5 p.T inv(M_full(q)) p + H_base(q,0); original numeric/reference field retains base solve implementation
metadata.recurrence: a_(k+1)=-(Da_k f + Df.T a_k)/(k+1); fixed expansion origin
